stem.text: Two chemicals, X and Y, react together in solution to give product Z.
The rate of formation of product Z at the start of the reaction was measured in five experiments, 1–5, using various concentrations of X and Y. The results are shown.

columns:
rate of formation of Z
at the start/$\text{mol dm}^{-3}\text{ s}^{-1}$

A.text: The rate of the reaction is directly proportional to the concentration of reagent X.

B.text: The rate of the reaction is directly proportional to the concentration of reagent Y.

C.text: The rate of the reaction is **not** affected by the concentration of reagent X.

D.text: The rate of the reaction is **not** affected by the concentration of reagent Y.
